# VENDORED.md (generated by exp_A4/tools/vendor.py; release copy)

Release note (fix attempt 1, 2026-10-27): only the wording and paths of the paragraphs below the table of repositories were changed from the frozen file; the tables and diffs are unchanged. The vendored `.py` files are byte-identical to the frozen tree (`exp_A4/code/vendored` = `exp_P0/code/vendored`).

Owner: eswa-experimenter-arch. Round 02, exp_A4. Concern: R2.2.

Rule: the backbones are copied from the official repositories at the pinned commits, not re-implemented. Only import paths and the einops calls were changed: the einops rearrange/repeat calls of the Crossformer files were replaced by equivalent torch operations and the einops import of iTransformer's `SelfAttention_Family.py` was made lazy (einops and reformer_pytorch are not installed in the project venv), and the changed files carry a modification header. Seven files are byte copies (see the table). The task heads and the input adapters live in `src/saca_rul/baselines.py`, outside this folder. In the project, test F1 (`exp_A4/tests/test_fidelity.py`, not part of this release and not re-run here) ran the unmodified fresh clones side by side and checked the outputs are equal.
